title: On the Escaping Efficiency of Distributed Adversarial Training Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2509.11337v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Adversarial training has been widely studied in recent years due to its role in improving model robustness against adversarial attacks. This paper focuses on comparing different distributed adversarial training algorithms--including centralized and decentralized strategies--within multi-agent learning environments. Previous studies have highlighted the importance of model flatness in determining robustness. To this end, we develop a general theoretical framework to study the escaping efficiency of these algorithms from local minima, which is closely related to the flatness of the resulting models. We show that when the perturbation bound is sufficiently small (i.e., when the attack strength is relatively mild) and a large batch size is used, decentralized adversarial training algorithms--including consensus and diffusion--are guaranteed to escape faster from local minima than the centralized strategy, thereby favoring flatter minima.

translated_title: 关于分布式对抗训练算法逃逸效率的研究
translated_abstract: 近年来，对抗训练因其在提升模型对对抗攻击鲁棒性方面的作用而受到广泛研究。本文重点比较多智能体学习环境中不同的分布式对抗训练算法——包括中心化与去中心化策略。已有研究强调了模型平坦性在决定鲁棒性方面的重要性。为此，我们构建了一个通用理论框架来研究这些算法从局部极小值逃逸的效率，该效率与所得模型的平坦性密切相关。我们证明，当扰动界足够小（即攻击强度相对温和）且使用大批量训练时，去中心化对抗训练算法——包括共识与扩散算法——被保证比中心化策略更快地从局部极小值逃逸，从而更有利于收敛到更平坦的极小值。
tldr: 本文构建了一个通用理论框架来分析分布式对抗训练算法从局部极小值逃逸的效率，并证明当攻击强度温和且使用大批量训练时，去中心化算法（共识与扩散）比中心化策略逃逸更快、更倾向于找到平坦的极小值。
